# GENERATED by tools/gen_can_empire.py - edit the generator, not this file.

# Canada after the British defeat: tiered spirit, unrest, India, ANZAC.

wif_can_adrift_ease = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_can_adrift_3 } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = wif_can_adrift_3 add_idea = wif_can_adrift_2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_can_adrift_2 } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = wif_can_adrift_2 add_idea = wif_can_adrift_1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_can_adrift_1 } remove_ideas = wif_can_adrift_1 }
}
wif_can_adrift_remove = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_can_adrift_1 } remove_ideas = wif_can_adrift_1 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_can_adrift_2 } remove_ideas = wif_can_adrift_2 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_can_adrift_3 } remove_ideas = wif_can_adrift_3 }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- setup
# CAN scope, from wif_peace_deal step 8 (after Britain's subjects have been
# set loose and Canada has its colonies and the Free Commonwealth).
wif_can_become_empire = {
	set_country_flag = wif_can_empire
	set_variable = { wif_can_iu = 50 }
	set_variable = { wif_can_iu_rate = 1 }
	set_variable = { wif_can_inu = 60 }
	set_variable = { wif_can_inu_rate = 0.5 }
	set_variable = { wif_can_ac = 60 }
	set_variable = { wif_can_ac_rate = -1 }
	set_variable = { wif_can_anzac_lost = 0 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = wif_can_adrift_3 } } add_ideas = wif_can_adrift_3 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = wif_can_quebec_idea } } add_ideas = wif_can_quebec_idea }
	# The land ANZAC Cohesion counts: Australia's and New Zealand's, and the Solomons
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				is_owned_by = AST
				is_owned_by = NZL
				state = 634
				state = 734
			}
		}
		set_state_flag = wif_can_anzac_state
	}
	wif_can_count_anzac_losses = yes
	set_variable = { wif_can_anzac_lost = wif_can_anzac_lost_now }
	wif_can_check_india = yes
	load_focus_tree = {
		tree = wif_can_empire_focus
		keep_completed = no
	}
}

# CAN scope. India drops out of the tree once the Raj is no longer ours.
wif_can_check_india = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_can_india_gone }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_can_india_dominion }
			NOT = { wif_can_holds_india = yes }
		}
		set_country_flag = wif_can_india_gone
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- monthly
# on_monthly_CAN
wif_can_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_can_empire }
		wif_can_check_india = yes
		wif_can_imperial_unrest_monthly = yes
		wif_can_indian_unrest_monthly = yes
		wif_can_anzac_monthly = yes
		wif_can_st_laurent_monthly = yes
	}
}

wif_can_imperial_unrest_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_can_iu_ended } }
		set_variable = { wif_can_iu_rate = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_war = yes } add_to_variable = { wif_can_iu_rate = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_can_iu_governors } add_to_variable = { wif_can_iu_rate = -0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_can_iu_velvet } add_to_variable = { wif_can_iu_rate = -0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_can_iu_hyde_park } add_to_variable = { wif_can_iu_rate = 0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_can_iu_no_rise } set_variable = { wif_can_iu_rate = 0 } }
		clamp_variable = { var = wif_can_iu_rate min = 0 max = 10 }
		add_to_variable = { wif_can_iu = wif_can_iu_rate }
		clamp_variable = { var = wif_can_iu min = 0 max = 100 }

		# Warning when it first crosses 60
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { wif_can_iu > 59.9 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_can_iu_warned }
			}
			set_country_flag = wif_can_iu_warned
			country_event = { id = wif_can.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_can_iu < 55 } }
			clr_country_flag = wif_can_iu_warned
		}

		# A warned revolt goes ahead next month if the unrest is still there
		if = {
			limit = { any_state = { has_state_flag = wif_can_revolt_pending } }
			random_state = {
				limit = { has_state_flag = wif_can_revolt_pending }
				clr_state_flag = wif_can_revolt_pending
				if = {
					limit = {
						ROOT = { check_variable = { wif_can_iu > 59.9 } }
						OR = {
							wif_can_revolt_candidate = yes
							AND = {
								NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT }
								OWNER = { wif_can_colony_can_revolt = yes }
							}
						}
					}
					wif_can_revolt_here = yes
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_can_iu > 59.9 } }
			random_list = {
				15 = {
					modifier = { factor = 2 check_variable = { wif_can_iu > 79.9 } }
					wif_can_pick_revolt = yes
				}
				85 = { }
			}
		}
	}
}

# CAN scope. Choose the colony that rises - a colony country, or a colonial
# state Canada owns - and either warn (RCMP) or let it rise at once.
wif_can_pick_revolt = {
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = { wif_can_revolt_candidate = yes }
		set_state_flag = wif_can_rc
	}
	every_subject_country = {
		limit = { wif_can_colony_can_revolt = yes }
		capital_scope = { set_state_flag = wif_can_rc }
	}
	random_state = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = wif_can_rc }
		if = {
			limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = wif_can_revolt_warning } }
			set_state_flag = wif_can_revolt_pending
			save_event_target_as = wif_can_revolt_state
			ROOT = { country_event = { id = wif_can.2 } }
		}
		else = {
			wif_can_revolt_here = yes
		}
	}
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = wif_can_rc }
		clr_state_flag = wif_can_rc
	}
	every_subject_country = {
		capital_scope = { clr_state_flag = wif_can_rc }
	}
}

# State scope, ROOT = Canada. The state (or the colony whose capital it is)
# rises in revolt.

# The rebel country.
wif_can_rebel_rises = {
	set_country_flag = wif_can_rebel
	if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Colonial Insurgents" } }
		division_template = {
			name = "Colonial Insurgents"
			priority = 0
			regiments = {
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 2 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = 1000 producer = ROOT }
	if = { limit = { tag = BAH } every_owned_state = { create_unit = { division = "division_template = \"Colonial Insurgents\" start_experience_factor = 0.2 start_equipment_factor = 0.8" owner = BAH count = 2 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { tag = BAS } every_owned_state = { create_unit = { division = "division_template = \"Colonial Insurgents\" start_experience_factor = 0.2 start_equipment_factor = 0.8" owner = BAS count = 2 } } }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- India
wif_can_indian_unrest_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { wif_can_holds_india = yes }
		set_variable = { wif_can_inu_rate = 0.5 }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_can_ordinance } add_to_variable = { wif_can_inu_rate = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_can_ifs_answered }
				country_exists = IFS
				RAJ = { any_neighbor_country = { tag = IFS } }
			}
			add_to_variable = { wif_can_inu_rate = 1 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { wif_can_inu = wif_can_inu_rate }
		clamp_variable = { var = wif_can_inu min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { wif_can_inu > 69.9 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_can_inu_warned }
			}
			set_country_flag = wif_can_inu_warned
			country_event = { id = wif_can.6 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_can_inu < 65 } }
			clr_country_flag = wif_can_inu_warned
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_can_inu > 79.9 } }
			random = {
				chance = 20
				country_event = { id = wif_can.3 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# CAN scope. Quit India: the Raj breaks free.
wif_can_quit_india = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = RAJ RAJ = { is_subject_of = ROOT } }
		end_puppet = RAJ
		RAJ = {
			if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
			set_country_flag = wif_can_quit_india
		}
	}
	set_country_flag = wif_can_india_gone
	add_to_variable = { wif_can_iu = 15 }
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_can_iu min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# CAN scope. The Dominion of India.
wif_can_india_becomes_dominion = {
	set_country_flag = wif_can_india_dominion
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = RAJ RAJ = { is_subject_of = ROOT } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_dlc = "Together for Victory" }
			set_autonomy = {
				target = RAJ
				autonomy_state = autonomy_dominion
				end_wars = no
			}
		}
		RAJ = { set_country_flag = wif_can_no_revolt }
		if = {
			limit = { is_faction_leader = yes NOT = { RAJ = { is_in_faction_with = ROOT } } }
			add_to_faction = RAJ
		}
	}
}

# RAJ scope. Raise the Indian Army: 6 infantry divisions.
wif_can_raj_raise_army = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Indian Infantry Division" } }
		division_template = {
			name = "Indian Infantry Division"
			priority = 1
			regiments = {
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 2 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 2 }
				infantry = { x = 2 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 2 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 2 y = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = 3000 producer = CAN }
	capital_scope = {
		create_unit = {
			division = "division_template = \"Indian Infantry Division\" start_experience_factor = 0.3 start_equipment_factor = 1.0"
			owner = RAJ
			count = 6
		}
	}
}

# CAN scope.
wif_can_garrison_template = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Colonial Garrison" } }
		division_template = {
			name = "Colonial Garrison"
			priority = 0
			regiments = {
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 1 }
			}
			support = {
				military_police = { x = 0 y = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- ANZAC
# CAN scope: how many ANZAC states Japan's side holds now.
wif_can_count_anzac_losses = {
	set_variable = { wif_can_anzac_lost_now = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = wif_can_anzac_state
			OR = {
				CONTROLLER = { wif_can_japan_side = yes }
				OWNER = { wif_can_japan_side = yes }
			}
		}
		# CAN by tag, not ROOT: at the peace ROOT is the United States
		CAN = { add_to_variable = { wif_can_anzac_lost_now = 1 } }
	}
}

wif_can_anzac_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_can_anzac_locked } }
		set_variable = { wif_can_ac_rate = -1 }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_can_ac_slower } set_variable = { wif_can_ac_rate = -0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_can_ac_no_fall } set_variable = { wif_can_ac_rate = 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { wif_can_ac = wif_can_ac_rate }
		# Japan's Pacific settlement: -20 at once
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = wif_jap_america_out_of_asia
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_can_ac_settlement_hit }
			}
			set_country_flag = wif_can_ac_settlement_hit
			add_to_variable = { wif_can_ac = -20 }
			wif_can_count_anzac_losses = yes
			set_variable = { wif_can_anzac_lost = wif_can_anzac_lost_now }
		}
		# -5 for every ANZAC state Japan's side has taken since last month
		wif_can_count_anzac_losses = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_can_anzac_lost_now > wif_can_anzac_lost } }
			set_temp_variable = { wif_can_ac_hit = wif_can_anzac_lost_now }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_can_ac_hit = wif_can_anzac_lost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { wif_can_ac_hit = -5 }
			add_to_variable = { wif_can_ac = wif_can_ac_hit }
		}
		set_variable = { wif_can_anzac_lost = wif_can_anzac_lost_now }
		clamp_variable = { var = wif_can_ac min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { wif_can_ac < 40 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_can_ac_warned }
			}
			set_country_flag = wif_can_ac_warned
			country_event = { id = wif_can.7 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_can_ac > 45 } }
			clr_country_flag = wif_can_ac_warned
		}
		# Below 30 each dominion may walk out
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_can_ac < 30 } }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						original_tag = AST
						original_tag = NZL
					}
					exists = yes
					is_in_faction_with = ROOT
					NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_can_anzac_left }
				}
				random = {
					chance = 10
					save_event_target_as = wif_can_anzac_leaver
					set_country_flag = wif_can_anzac_left
					leave_faction = yes
					ROOT = { country_event = { id = wif_can.4 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- St. Laurent
wif_can_st_laurent_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = wif_can_st_laurent
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_can_st_laurent_done }
			date > 1948.11.14
			has_government = democratic
		}
		set_country_flag = wif_can_st_laurent_done
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_character = CAN_louis_st_laurent } }
			recruit_character = CAN_louis_st_laurent
		}
		add_country_leader_role = {
			character = CAN_louis_st_laurent
			promote_leader = yes
			country_leader = {
				ideology = liberalism
				traits = { }
				expire = "1965.1.1.1"
			}
		}
		country_event = { id = wif_can.8 }
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the end
# CAN scope. The Empire Endures.
wif_can_empire_endures = {
	set_country_flag = wif_can_iu_ended
	clr_country_flag = wif_can_iu_warned
	every_state = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = wif_can_revolt_pending }
		clr_state_flag = wif_can_revolt_pending
	}
	set_variable = { wif_can_cw_count = 1 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_in_faction_with = ROOT NOT = { tag = ROOT } }
		ROOT = { add_to_variable = { wif_can_cw_count = 1 } }
	}
	set_variable = { wif_can_cw_stab = wif_can_cw_count }
	multiply_variable = { wif_can_cw_stab = 0.05 }
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_can_cw_stab min = 0 max = 0.25 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_can_commonwealth_strength }
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_in_faction_with = ROOT NOT = { tag = ROOT } }
		set_variable = { wif_can_cw_stab = ROOT.wif_can_cw_stab }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_can_commonwealth_strength }
	}
}

# CAN scope. Suppress Unrest.
wif_can_suppress_unrest = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = wif_can_suppress_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_can_suppress_double }
			add_to_variable = { wif_can_iu = -16 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { wif_can_iu = -8 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_can_suppress_garrison }
			add_to_variable = { wif_can_iu = -2 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = wif_can_iu min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	add_stability = -0.02
}
